name: Sammy's Woodfried Pizza
notes: Own site (sammyspizza.com) and DoorDash both 403'd on curl/WebFetch (bot protection). sammyspizza.com's own Olo storefront (sammyswoodfiredpizza.olo.com/menu/sammys-san-marcos-2, serve-next.olo.com) is a fully client-fetched Next.js app with no server-embedded price state -- needs a browser. Used Sammy's own Slice storefront instead (listed there as "Sammy's Restaurant & Bar", address-confirmed exact match: 121 S Las Posas Rd, San Marcos, CA 92078), extracted 75 priced dishes from __SLICE_REDUX_STATE__ JSON across 9 sections (Woodfired Pizzas, Shareables, Soups, Salads, Tacos & Burgers, Pastas, Entrees, Kids Menu, Desserts). Ran the markup division test against 1.03/1.04/1.05/1.08/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25/1.30 -- no divisor cleared more than 14/76 items to round or half-dollar values, i.e. no uniform markup signature; prices carry restaurant-native odd cents (e.g. 23.10, 22.52, 24.83), consistent with a first-party POS price list rather than a delivery surcharge. Excluded a 1-item "Non Display Products" category and any zero-price rows.
